plan.notes: Transcribed from the official 2025-2026 LATTC General Catalog (lattc.edu). Semester sequences, course codes, titles, and unit values transcribed exactly as published. The catalog does not state course prerequisites for these sequences. Certificate: 40 units, all sequenced.

courses.title: Rail System Overview, Safety, Tools, and Mechanical Principles
courses.choice_note: Catalog offers alternative: DIESLTK 401A Rail Systems Overview, Safety and Tools (5) + DIESLTK 401B Mechanical Principles (5) instead of the single 10-unit course.

courses.title: Rail Electrical and Electronic Principles
courses.choice_note: Catalog offers alternative: DIESLTK 402A Rail Electrical Principles (5) + DIESLTK 402B Rail Electronic Principles (5) instead of the single 10-unit course.

courses.title: Rail Vehicle Pneumatic & Hydraulic Controls, HVAC & Car Body
courses.choice_note: Catalog offers alternative: DIESLTK 403A Rail Vehicle Pneumatic & Hydraulic Controls (5) + DIESLTK 403B Rail Vehicle HVAC and Car Body (5) instead of the single 10-unit course.

courses.title: Rail Diesel Engine Fundamentals and Rail Accessory/Support Systems
courses.choice_note: Catalog offers alternative: DIESLTK 404A Rail Diesel Engine Fundamentals (5.5) + DIESLTK 404B Rail Accessory/Support Systems (4.5) instead of the single 10-unit course.
